about: Patches for the few cases GradeForge's automatic model resolution gets wrong or cannot know. This is not a list of supported models: any model Ollama serves is identified and resolved automatically.

qwen35.qlora_note: Unsloth advises against 4-bit QLoRA for Qwen 3.5 (larger-than-usual quantization error); use 16-bit LoRA.
